baselinePolicy: Hooks run through Xenon's instruction-hook contract (hint kind "instruction"), implemented in revisions/usa-retail-tu0/hooks/. Two classes are enabled: base-executable fixes - changes the official title update makes, which this base executable lacks - and host-timing fixes - races and clock drift the 360's fixed cores and steady 30 fps hid, which a PC host exposes. Optional enhancements and research probes stay disabled metadata.

hooks.name: ac6StorageOrderHookOp2
hooks.rationale: The retail title update stores each storage job's operation code to [job+4] before JobPoolB::Submit; this base executable stores it after, so a fast pool-B worker can run a reused job with the previous operation. The hook applies the title update's ordering at this call site.

hooks.name: ac6EffectModeSubmitHook
hooks.rationale: The effect update and draw jobs share one plain mode word at [manager+0xA1E84] that the worker reads after submit; on a PC host a second submit can overwrite it before the first job reads it, so both jobs draw (one-frame doubled effects/clouds). This hook records the mode at submit time for ac6EffectModeDispatchHook.

hooks.name: ac6EffectModeDispatchHook
hooks.rationale: Dispatches each effect job from the mode recorded at its submit (update 0x822B2E20, 0x822B0848, or the class's draw at vtbl[+0x100]) and returns; a job with no record runs the original dispatcher.

hooks.name: ac6CutsceneResyncHookDD
hooks.rationale: The cutscene sequencer ticks once per rendered frame while its soundtrack follows the audio clock; render hitches on the PC host leave the picture permanently behind the sound. Audio stays master; the timeline catches up by at most 3 extra ticks per frame once 2 ticks behind.

hooks.name: ac6CutsceneResyncHookEM
hooks.rationale: Same resync for the in-mission story cutscene sequencer.
